_note: The far rank is a curtain of leaf now, not a crowd of crowns, and a curtain shows a repeating pattern the way a crowd of rolled cards never did. This asks what the curtain should wear, how big the wear should be, and whether the leaf should be cut at all. `tile` (2 m as built) is the metres of curtain one repeat of the canvas covers, baked into the mesh's UVs by `skylineBand`; live, multiplying the texture's uScale/vScale weighs another tile (uScale 1.5 is a 1.33 m tile, uScale 0.667 is a 3 m tile). `warp` (1 as built) pulls the pattern off its grid in the geometry and cannot be turned off live — that comparison was made between two runs of this plan with and without it in `src/world.js`. The `curtain` camera stands on the west lawn and looks WEST at the near face of the band, forty-odd metres off; the `west` view is a standing camera and its two middle picks name jungleHighBelt at 77-81 m.

cases.name: 2 m tile, the leaf cut out of the curtain
cases.js: const t = mats.jungleFar.albedoTexture; t.hasAlpha = true; mats.jungleFar.alphaCutOff = 0.5; mats.jungleFar.transparencyMode = 1;

cases.name: 2 m tile, cut high so only the pale leaf stands
cases.js: const t = mats.jungleFar.albedoTexture; t.hasAlpha = true; mats.jungleFar.alphaCutOff = 0.72; mats.jungleFar.transparencyMode = 1;
